people.name: Beth-barah
people.line: Place where Gideon stationed men to intercept the Midianites.

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Gideon
people.line: Judge of Israel; defeated Midianites; tested and reassured by God.

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

people.name: Midian
people.line: A nation descended from Abraham; oppressed Israel in the time of the judges

translations.web: Gideon sent messengers throughout all the hill country of Ephraim, saying, “Come down against Midian and take the waters before them as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan!” So all the men of Ephraim were gathered together and took the waters as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan.
translations.bsb: Gideon sent messengers throughout the hill country of Ephraim to say, “Come down against the Midianites and seize the waters of the Jordan ahead of them as far as Beth-barah.” So all the men of Ephraim were called out, and they captured the waters of the Jordan as far as Beth-barah.
translations.kjv: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim, saying, Come down against the Midianites, and take before them the waters unto Bethbarah and Jordan. Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and took the waters unto Bethbarah and Jordan.
translations.asv: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all the hill-country of Ephraim, saying, Come down against Midian, and take before them the waters, as far as Beth-barah, even the Jordan. So all the men of Ephraim were gathered together, and took the waters as far as Beth-barah, even the Jordan.
